subject: The secret confession about your relationship patterns
preview_text: I wasn't going to show you this side-by-side comparison, but it reveals something critical about your last 30 days.
body_paragraphs: Remember that gut feeling you had two weeks ago? The one you talked yourself out of? Let me show you what happens when you listen to it versus when you ignore it. This isn't a theory—it's what I've seen in the data from people who use this tool versus those who let it sit.

Without the scanner: You second-guess yourself for 30 days. You replay conversations in your head at 2 AM. You make excuses for behavior that makes your stomach drop. You waste emotional energy trying to decode mixed signals alone. With the scanner: You have clarity in 30 seconds instead of 30 days of anxiety. You see the patterns instead of getting lost in the moment. You protect your peace instead of negotiating your boundaries. The difference isn't just time—it's your mental health.

This is why the pattern detection feature exists. It's not about finding problems; it's about ending the cycle of overthinking. When you scan conversations over time, the AI connects the dots you might miss in the emotional fog. It shows you the trajectory, not just a single red flag.

Open the app right now and look at your dashboard. See your activity (or lack of it) from the last two weeks. That timeline tells a story. P.S. The 800+ people who caught toxic patterns early? They all had one thing in common—they used the scanner when their gut first whispered, not when their heart was already breaking.
